display.purpose: Hero and intro name only; last word glows in accent.

shadows.name: accent-ring-bloom
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 50%, transparent), 0 0 24px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 25%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Hover and focus on level cards, and the logo mark.

shadows.name: text-glow
shadows.purpose: Highlighted last word of the name.

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance (0.6s) for hero and intro elements.

motion.name: lift
motion.value: translateY(-2px) on buttons, translateY(-4px) on level cards

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action: accent fill, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #00e5ff; color: #0b1017; padding: 10px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #eef6ff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as CV downloads and contact.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #eef6ff; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #22303f; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #00e5ff; color: #00e5ff; outline: none; }

components.name: Tech Chip
components.description: Technology tag with a brand glyph; accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #22303f; border-radius: 9999px; background: #19243433; color: #7d91a3; font-size: 14px; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #00e5ff; border-color: #00e5ff; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat surface with a hairline border and an optional 3px accent bar.
components.html:
Senior Software Engineer

Flat at rest, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #121a26; color: #d3e0ec; border: 1px solid #22303f; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; } .ds-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 3px; background: #00e5ff; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #eef6ff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Level Card
components.description: Intro level-select tile: icon, level number, title, blurb; lifts and glows on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-level { display: block; width: 220px; text-align: left; background: #121a26; border: 1px solid #22303f; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-level:hover, .ds-level:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #00e5ff; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,229,255,0.5), 0 0 24px rgba(0,229,255,0.25); } .ds-level-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-level-num { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #7d91a3; } .ds-level-title { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-family: Orbitron, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: #eef6ff; } .ds-level-blurb { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #7d91a3; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio reads like an instrument panel: a near-black field with a faint HUD grid, hairline-bordered panels, and a single neon accent that lights up only what matters. Sections are "levels", the sidebar is a status rail, and the About aside is a player card. The game framing is a navigation and scanning device, so a recruiter can find the CV, the proof and the contact in seconds.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first HUD: tonal surfaces, hairline borders, a faint 48px grid and an accent bloom at the top edge
One accent at a time; the accent pair is user-swappable through six presets
Orbitron for naming, Barlow for reading, Share Tech Mono for readouts
Game vocabulary (levels, player card, press start) as wayfinding

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only action color on a screen. Lime marks status and reward, never a call to action.

rules.name: The Variable Accent Rule
rules.body: Always var(--accent) / var(--accent-2); any hex that matches a preset in a component is a bug, because it breaks theme switching.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for labels, periods and levels. Never use it for paragraphs.

rules.name: The Wide Voice Rule
rules.body: Orbitron is uppercase and display-only; do not set body copy or long strings in it.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: Panels sit flat at rest. Glow appears on hover, focus or the logo; it is never added to resting content.

dos: Do use var(--accent) and var(--accent-2) so every theme preset works.
Do keep the game vocabulary (levels, player card, press start) as navigation, with the real content always one click or scroll away.
Do keep monospace labels uppercase with wide tracking, and Orbitron uppercase with wide tracking.
Do separate sections with a hairline border and 80px padding rather than boxes or shadows.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and the in-site motion toggle; entrances use the exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS landing template: no gradient heroes, icon-card feature grids or stock testimonials.
Don't over-gamify: no XP bars, fake loot or decorative mechanics that slow a recruiter down.
Don't go 8-bit, pixel-art or skeuomorphic; the HUD stays clean and modern.
Don't drift to a cold corporate résumé look: keep the accent, the grid and the wide display type.
Don't put glow on resting content, use gradient text, or hard-code a preset's hex value in a component.
